question: Who won the ‘Fielder of the Match’ medal in the ICC Women’s World Cup 2025 final for her exceptional fielding performance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amanjot Kaur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India all-rounder Amanjot Kaur received the ‘Fielder of the Match’ medal for her outstanding fielding performance in the ICC Women’s World Cup 2025 final against South Africa.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amanjot Kaur ran out South African opener Tazmin Brits, shifting the match momentum in India’s favor.**
 
• She took a stunning catch to dismiss Proteas captain and top scorer Laura Wolvaardt.
 
• Her brilliant fielding efforts played a pivotal role in India’s 52-run victory over South Africa.
 
• Kaur contributed with both bat and ball throughout the tournament, scoring 146 runs and taking 6 wickets in 7 matches.

 [IMAGE: //cdn.testbook.com/resources/lms_creative_elements/additional-info-image.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India clinched their maiden ICC Women’s World Cup title, defeating South Africa by 52 runs in Navi Mumbai.
 
• Deepti Sharma starred with 5/39, while Shafali Verma scored 87 and picked 2 wickets.
 
• Laura Wolvaardt’s century (101) for South Africa went in vain as India sealed a historic triumph.
